guesses.detail: Missing lr/batch/seed/initialization: Adam0.001,defaultbetas,eps1e-8,batch64,seed42,PyTorchdefaultlayerinitializers. User authorized routine missing-detail defaults; no tuning.

Figure 3 input dimensions of 100×100×3 and the exact 616,504 parameters require upsampling grayscale MNIST to 100×100 and repeating three channels. Implemented with torch.nn.functional.interpolate(mode="bilinear", align_corners=False), then expand; this is separate from Pillow resizing used for RGB.
Prose says eachconv followedpool, but Figure3 and exactly616504parameters prove fourpools before finalconv. Figure/count evidence preferred.

For RGB only, the related author XAI code uses cv2.resize and RGB conversion; this independent run uses Pillow Image.Resampling.BILINEAR with RGB conversion. Both produce 100×100 RGB inputs, but library pixel rounding can differ. MNIST uses PyTorch interpolation, as recorded separately.
Use final-epoch online trainingaccuracy and finalcheckpoint testaccuracy; no test-basedmodelselection or augmentation.

conclusion_assessment.summary: The tested RGB-versus-MNIST ordering is reproduced: RGB achieves 97.83333% test accuracy using 10,490 training images, versus MNIST 88.38539% using 27,455. The reported absolute test performance is not recovered, particularly MNIST: 88.38539% versus 97.12%. This supports only part of the recognition findings.
evidence: Paper section IV-C and Tables 1-2 state that RGB attains higher accuracy with fewer training images; the completed rgb-full and mnist-full runs preserve that ordering.
The reproduced RGB-minus-MNIST gap is 9.44794 percentage points. Published RGB accuracy is 99.72%; reproduced is 97.83333%.
Both runs reached 100% recorded training accuracy while held-out accuracy was lower; these results do not establish the paper section IV-B assertion that no overfitting occurs.
limits: These are comparisons across different datasets, not a controlled demonstration that RGB representation alone causes the improvement.
LEXSET continuation is in progress; three-dataset comparison pending. Historical validation membership remains unspecified.
Communication/channel simulations were outside the assigned scope; no conclusion about the proposed communication system is reproduced by these recognition runs alone.
